arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Ortiz argued the Petition Clause does not create a broad employment right.
Mr. Schnapper argued the clause protects petitions regardless of public concern.
Mr. Palmore argued the Third Circuit rule is fundamentally flawed.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the scope of the Petition Clause for public employees. The borough argues the clause does not cover private matters. The employee argues the clause protects all petitions to the government.
